sources: oldschool.runescape.wiki strategy pages (presets, recommended stats, inventories)
wvanderp/osrs-db (MIT, item stats + equip requirements → generated into gear.json)
meta.notes: Presets are hand-curated starting points, not DPS-calculator output. Item stats, equip requirements and prices come from gear.json, generated by tools/build-gear.ts — rerun it whenever preset item lists change.

bosses.name: Fight Caves
bosses.tagline: TzHaar's 63-wave endurance run — the fire cape rite of passage.
bosses.location: TzHaar city, under the Karamja volcano (no quest needed to enter)

skills.note: Protect from Magic/Ranged — non-negotiable for Jad

recommended.note: 61 is possible with patience; higher = faster waves
Below ~65 the wave 60–62 bats and mages hit hard
More HP = more room for prayer-switch mistakes

presets.name: Budget
presets.description: First-attempt gear — everything buyable for well under 100k. Dragon Slayer I covers the black d'hide body.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: The whole run is prayer-gated — never run dry

inventory.name: Emergency teleport
inventory.note: Ring of dueling in the ring slot doubles as this

presets.notes: Broad bolts are the classic cheap ammo (55 Slayer to equip — check yours). Adamant bolts hit the same +100 ranged strength without the Slayer gate. Swap to Ruby bolts (e) for Jad's 250 HP.

presets.name: Comfortable
presets.description: ~15–20m of upgrades: the crossbow and necklace carry the run. Karil's needs 70 Defence; Barrows gloves need Recipe for Disaster.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Faster kills = fewer waves per sip

inventory.name: Saradomin brew(4)
inventory.note: Jad panic-button heals

inventory.name: Super restore(4)
inventory.note: Restores what the brews drain

presets.notes: Dragon bolts can only be fired from a rune/dragon/Armadyl crossbow. Barrows gloves need full Recipe for Disaster — black d'hide vambraces are the stand-in until then.

presets.name: Best (no raids)
presets.description: Pre-raid best-in-slot. Ava's assembler needs Dragon Slayer II to make; everything else is GE-buyable.
presets.notes: A Toxic blowpipe (75 Ranged) clears waves faster than a crossbow, but most players still kill Jad with bolts. Imbue the archers ring at Nightmare Zone for +50% effect. The true endgame item is the Twisted bow — a raid drop.

bosses.notes: Tag the three healers off Jad before finishing him, and prayer-switch on his animation: legs curling = ranged, head rearing = magic. Death is safe (items kept) — the only real cost is the hour.

bosses.name: Giant Mole
bosses.tagline: Falador Park's overgrown rodent — the classic first boss.
bosses.location: Mole Lair, under Falador Park (bring a spade and a light source)

recommended.note: She's crush-resistant — bring your best non-crush weapon
Protect from Melee makes her harmless

presets.name: Budget
presets.description: A plain obsidian melee set — often already on mid-game accounts. The berserker necklace multiplies obsidian-weapon damage.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Only needed if praying

inventory.name: Super combat potion(4)
inventory.note: Or Attack/Strength potions

inventory.name: Spade
inventory.note: To enter the lair

inventory.name: Light source
inventory.note: Candle, lantern or Firemaking cape — the lair is pitch dark

presets.notes: The mole digs away at random — watch the dirt direction, or turn RuneLite's mole locator on. Stamina potions help between digs.

presets.name: Best (no raids)
presets.description: The whip upgrade path. Helm of Neitiznot needs The Fremennik Isles; Barrows gloves need Recipe for Disaster; Fighter torso is Barbarian Assault rewarded.
presets.notes: Fighter torso (free, from Barbarian Assault) is nearly as good as Bandos. Primordial boots edge out dragon boots if you're rich. Imbue the berserker ring for the real upgrade.

bosses.notes: Baby mole ticks damage in the last phase — step away or ignore them. Mole skins/claws trade for bird nests and tree seeds at Wyson.

bosses.name: Barrows
bosses.tagline: Six crypt brothers, one chest — the original gear minigame.

recommended.note: Iban's Blast shreds the melee brothers through their armour
Each brother prays against one style — overheads cover their attacks
Ahrim and Karil hit through gaps in melee armour

presets.name: Budget
presets.description: Iban's Blast + mystic. Underground Pass unlocks the staff; until then a fire bolt setup (or your melee gear) works at half speed.

inventory.name: Iban blast runes
inventory.note: Death + fire runes — the staff holds the charges (see the wiki for exact costs)

inventory.name: Spade
inventory.note: To open the crypts

inventory.name: Teleport out
inventory.note: Ring of dueling (worn) teleports to clan wars to reset

presets.notes: Kill Dharok first with Protect from Melee on — he's the one-shot machine. Ahrim (magic) and Karil (ranged) need their matching prayers switched on quickly.

presets.name: Best (no raids)
presets.description: The upgraded staff holds 2,500 casts. Trident of the Seas (75 Magic) beats Iban's if you have the levels and Zulrah scales.
presets.notes: Morytania legs 3 (In Aid of the Myreque reward) give unlimited Burgh de Rott teleports — a short run from Barrows. Huge for trip speed.

bosses.notes: The reward roll scales with kill count and potential — always loot the chest after all six brothers. Unwanted sets are a steady prayer-experience income.

bosses.name: Obor
bosses.tagline: Hill giant champion of the Edgeville sewers — F2P's first real boss.
bosses.location: Obor's lair, Edgeville Dungeon (giant key required — hill giant drop)

recommended.note: With 40 Prayer, Protect from Missiles blanks his ranged slams

presets.name: F2P melee
presets.description: Full rune — the platebody needs Dragon Slayer I. Cheap, effective, and every F2P account ends up here.

inventory.name: Giant key
inventory.note: One per kill — hill giants drop them

presets.notes: His ranged shock hits through melee armour — 40+ Prayer keeps it off you entirely (Protect from Missiles).

presets.name: Members melee
presets.description: The same obsidian set that carries Giant Mole. Bring a couple of binding spells for fewer chases.
presets.notes: Entangle or Ice Rush keeps him still — members' convenience.

bosses.notes: His slam attack can be avoided by staying out of melee range for a beat — watch for the animation.

bosses.name: Bryophyta
bosses.tagline: The moss giant matriarch — Obor's ranged-friendly cousin in Varrock sewers.
bosses.location: Bryophyta's lair, Varrock Sewers (mossy key required — moss giant drop)

recommended.note: Wiki strategy: ranging her is the mid-level F2P play
Protect from Magic before you open the gate

presets.name: F2P ranged
presets.description: Green d'hide and a maple shortbow. A rune scimitar melee setup works too if your melee is higher.

inventory.name: Mossy key
inventory.note: One per kill — moss giants drop them

presets.notes: Below ~75% HP she may summon three growthlings — kill them with an axe or secateurs (magic secateurs work) to resume damaging her. Protection prayers are fully effective here; keep Protect from Magic up.

bosses.notes: Growthling melee damage still lands while you pray Magic — bring food, not just prayer potions.

bosses.name: Sarachnis
bosses.tagline: The spider queen of Forthos Dungeon — mid-game melee training with real drops.
bosses.location: Forthos Dungeon, south-west of Hosidius (no requirements)

recommended.note: Her melee and ranged hits bounce off 70+ defence
Tank the melee spawn, pray against the magic one

presets.name: Melee
presets.description: Whip-and-defender mid-game gear. Your obsidian set from Giant Mole works while you build toward this.

inventory.name: Antivenom+(4)
inventory.note: Spiderling spawns poison

presets.notes: Fighter torso + obsidian platelegs is the budget stand-in. She webs the floor — stamp the web tiles to free yourself.

bosses.notes: Egg spawns hatch spiderlings — clear them or they stack poison damage. Instanced and non-instanced versions both exist.

bosses.name: Zulrah
bosses.tagline: The serpent of Zulrah — magic/ranged rotations, the mid-game wall every account climbs.
bosses.location: Zul-Andra, east of Tyras (charter ship or Zul-Andra teleport — no quest needed)

recommended.note: Trident territory; 80+ makes the rotations comfortable
Blowpipe for the ranged rotations
Her magic is more accurate than her ranged — plan prayer accordingly
Protect from Magic through most rotations

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + Ahrim's. The Seers ring you already own slots right in until you can afford a Magus ring.

inventory.name: Runes / scales
inventory.note: Trident charges: 1 chaos + 5 fire + 10 water per cast

inventory.name: Antivenom+(4)
inventory.note: Snakeling poison stacks

presets.notes: An imbued god cape (Mage Arena II) upgrades the cape slot. Most learners die to the Jad phase — switch prayers on her head bob, not the hit.

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Blowpipe + Karil's for the blue (ranged) rotations; most killers still bring a magic switch.

inventory.name: Scales + darts
inventory.note: Blowpipe burns ~2 scales per 3 shots (Zulrah drops both)

presets.notes: Realistically Zulrah is a two-style fight — treat this as the ranged half of a switch setup.

bosses.notes: Learn the four standard rotations (there are good cheat-sheet images on the wiki). Deaths are cheap; the 100-kill learning curve is the real cost.

bosses.name: Dagannoth Kings
bosses.tagline: Rex, Prime and Supreme under Waterbirth Island — the ring-drop trio.

recommended.note: Supreme (melee-vulnerable) wants a whip
Rex is the magic target — 75 for a trident
Prime falls to a crossbow
Each king attacks one style — overheads make you nearly immune

presets.name: Rex · Magic
presets.description: Solo-Rex: lure him around the rocks and blast. Iban's staff (Underground Pass) is the budget stand-in; fire bolt + chaos gauntlets works before that.

inventory.name: Trident charges / runes
inventory.note: Or Iban blast runes: 1 fire + 2 death per cast

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Protect from Magic vs Rex's nothing — it's for the dungeon

presets.notes: Rex only melees and can't reach you behind the rocks — the classic first-soloable-king. Chaos gauntlets (Family Crest) boost fire bolt while you work toward a trident.

presets.name: Prime · Ranged
presets.description: Crossbow + d'hide, praying Magic the whole time. Ruby bolts (e) punch through his HP.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Prime hits constant magic

presets.notes: Prime wanders — tag him and drag him to a safe corner before settling in.

presets.name: Supreme · Melee
presets.description: Whip + defender, praying Ranged. The most straightforward of the three for a melee main.
presets.notes: Supreme's ranged attack is the only thing that hurts while you pray — kill the spinolyps between respawns for peace.

bosses.notes: The Fremennik Trials gate is soft: the Rellekka guards let you in once you've STARTED the quest, which is when the boat becomes usable. Kings respawn quickly — most learners start with solo Rex. Watch the 81-Agility crevice shortcut for faster trips.

bosses.name: Vorkath
bosses.tagline: The blue dragon of Ungael — OSRS's most consistent money-maker.
bosses.location: Ungael, reachable after Dragon Slayer II

recommended.note: Or 80 Magic — pick one style and commit to it
Dragonfire is the real threat, not the melee
Protect from Magic through the fight

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Dragon hunter crossbow + dragon bolts is the Vorkath meta. A rune crossbow with dragon bolts is the budget stand-in until you can afford the DHCB.

inventory.name: Super antifire potion(4)
inventory.note: Non-negotiable — his dragonfire is the fight

inventory.name: Ruby → diamond bolt swap
inventory.note: Ruby (e) for the first ~65%, Diamond dragon bolts (e) after

inventory.name: Antivenom+ / antidote++
inventory.note: His ranged spit venoms

presets.notes: The Dragonfire shield needs Dragon Slayer I and 75 Defence; an Anti-dragon shield (Dragon Slayer I) works at any Defence while you build toward it. Dodge the acid pools in his last phase.

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + Ahrim's. The occult and seers ring you already own slot right in.
presets.notes: The imbued god cape is a Mage Arena II reward — the plain god cape (Mage Arena I) is the stand-in.

bosses.notes: His 'blue fireball' special is a line-of-sight dodge — step sideways, don't tank it. Count his attacks to predict the acid pool phase.

bosses.name: Phantom Muspah
bosses.location: Muspah's lair, reachable after Secrets of the North

recommended.note: Trident territory; 75 is the floor
His ranged phase hits through prayer gaps
Switch overheads with his attack style

presets.name: Magic
presets.description: Trident + Ahrim's through both phases. The occult and seers ring you already own slot straight in.

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: His smite phase drains prayer hard

inventory.name: Stamina potion(4)
inventory.note: He teleports across the lair constantly

presets.notes: He's only 33% susceptible to freezes — keep him in the north-west corner with a step-under lure instead of relying on freeze.

presets.name: Ranged
presets.description: Blowpipe for the walk phases. Most killers run a magic switch — treat this as the ranged half.
presets.notes: Prayer switch is the whole fight — ranged phase hits through Protect from Magic and vice versa. Watch for the smite attack's prayer-drain debuff.

bosses.notes: His freeze resistance means 33% reduced freeze duration — don't plan around full freezes. Bring a spade? No — that's for Barrows. Venom is the main chip damage.

bosses.name: God Wars Dungeon
bosses.tagline: The four generals — Bandos, Armadyl, Saradomin, Zamorak.
bosses.location: Trollheim, north-west of Burthorpe (40 kill count per boss)

recommended.note: Graardor tanking wants 80+ melee
The generals hit through prayer gaps
Kree'arra's ranged team
One overhead per general's style

presets.name: General Graardor · Melee
presets.description: The classic team boss. Bandos' Stronghold door needs 70 Strength and a hammer.

inventory.name: Hammer
inventory.note: Opens Bandos' Stronghold door

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Trips live and die on prayer

presets.notes: 40 kill count (20 with an ecumenical key from Wilderness bosses) before the door opens. Tank prays Melee, teammates Ranged. Godsword shards are the chase drop.

presets.name: Kree'arra · Ranged
presets.description: Armadyl's Eyrie needs 70 Ranged and a mith grapple to cross the chasm.

inventory.name: Mith grapple
inventory.note: Crosses the chasm to Armadyl's Eyrie

inventory.name: Prayer potion(4)
inventory.note: Protect from Ranged against Kree'arra

presets.notes: 40 kill count (or ecumenical key). Armadyl crossbow and dragon bolts are the ranged meta here; a rune crossbow with diamond bolts (e) works on a budget.

bosses.notes: Commander Zilyana's chamber needs 70 Agility (unboostable) + two ropes on the first visit; K'ril Tsutsaroth's needs no extra level. Zamorakian/Saradominist kill count opens those doors. Teams split the four generals for their godsword hilts.
